brief.prompt:
INITIAL GENERATION PROMPT
Use case: illustration-story.
Create exactly ONE finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, landscape 16:9, 1792×1024 or 1920×1080, PNG, at least 1000 pixels wide. All typography must be generated as part of the image.
Style reference: the approved black-and-lime thumbnail already inspected in this conversation (B-culver-black-lime-v3.png). Match its confident chunky Japanese typography, hand-drawn black ink and dry brush rendering, charcoal #151A18, acid lime #CCF43B, warm ivory and a single orange basketball. Do NOT reuse its old headline, player, date or statistics. This is a new design, not a copy of its jump-shot layout.

Subject: Exactly one REAL player, Yutaka Tsukamoto / 塚本雄貴 of Tokushima, chosen randomly from players named in the fixed manuscript. His official current portrait was inspected at https://gambarous.jp/team/players/detail/id=46555?PlayerID=22403 with portrait https://gambarous.jp/files/user/2-TSUKAMOTO.jpg. The photo is ONLY a likeness reference, never paste or reproduce the official photo. Draw him entirely as a vigorous hand-inked editorial illustration. Carefully preserve his recognizable traits from the viewed official portrait: young Japanese adult man, athletic compact guard build, warm light skin, oval face with moderately broad jaw and small rounded chin, straight dark brows, slightly narrow dark eyes, straight nose, full lower lip, faint sparse moustache and tiny chin stubble. Distinctive center-parted bleached sandy-blond curtain hair, dark roots and dark closely trimmed sides; fringes curl gently outward over the temples. No black curly hairstyle, no beard, no invented person. Face large and legible, with ivory and warm gray modeled highlights instead of solid black shadows.

Composition: Dramatic low dribbling drive toward the viewer, forward-leaning torso and bent knees, not a jump shot. Three-quarter view with his head turned slightly toward the left while still showing both eyes. Place the player on the RIGHT 45% of the frame; head around upper-right third; orange ball fully inside frame near his hip and knee, one anatomically sound hand contacting the top of the ball, other arm bent naturally for balance. His blond hairstyle, face, hands and ball fully visible. Plain unbranded dark basketball jersey with ivory/lime edging, no names, numbers, sponsor lettering, club or league logos. No opponent, no crowd faces. Energetic diagonal lime dry-brush slashes behind the player, not over his facial features. This is a generic imagined basketball movement, NOT a reconstruction of a real game and NOT a claim that he played on this date.

Text: Use exactly these Japanese strings, with NO extra copy and NO player name, performance statistics or scores. Everything in safe margins of at least 64 pixels. Text occupies the LEFT 55% without overlapping the face or hands.
Small masthead at top-left: "バスケまとめ"
Small date/status line below: "2026.11.16｜試合前"
Major ivory headline: "今季平均EFF"
Dominant huge lime headline immediately below: "ベスト5"
Medium plain typography line (NOT logos): "B.PREMIER / B.ONE"
Readable supporting line: "リーグ別・登録選手から選出"
Clearly readable ivory outlined pill or underline: "出場未確定"
Bottom-left on calm dark background, readable small footer: "イラスト（AI生成）"
Beside it: "イメージ"

Editorial truth: This article compares season-average EFF among registered players for the listed date, separately by league. It does NOT describe a confirmed starting five, game-day results, actual appearances, or a cross-league ranking. The illustrated player was randomly selected and is not being presented with any personal accomplishment. Do not add any name, team name, statistics, score, winner, match-up, tournament emblem or scoreboard.
Quality: Bold polished thumbnail, few visual elements, balanced negative space, Japanese letters correct and crisp, no clipped text or ball, normal hands and fingers, clearly illustrated rather than photorealistic. Opaque background.

ONE ALLOWED REVISION PROMPT
Edit this existing thumbnail for final framing and likeness corrections, preserving the design and EVERY Japanese text string verbatim.
Image 1 is the edit target: the black-and-lime Japanese basketball thumbnail just generated.
Image 2 is ONLY a likeness reference: the official portrait of real player Yutaka Tsukamoto / 塚本雄貴. Do NOT paste the photograph or copy the uniform, logo, sponsor, number, or ball branding.

Required single correction pass:
1) Reframe ONLY the player illustration on the right: reduce the entire illustrated player and ball by approximately 16% and position them so there is at least 55 px clearance above his hair and 55 px clearance to the right of his hand and the ENTIRE basketball. The ball must be completely inside the canvas, not touching the edge. Keep his dynamic low dribbling pose and large recognizable face. His legs may naturally extend beyond the bottom edge; his HEAD, BOTH HANDS, and BALL may NOT be cut off. Extend the dark background and lime brush strokes into the freed space.
2) Make his hairstyle more faithful to Image 2: less voluminous, less wavy, flatter smooth sandy-blond curtain haircut with center part, visible dark roots and short dark sides, hair falls near temples without big curls. Preserve the distinctive oval face, broad jaw, straight eyebrows, narrow dark eyes, straight nose and full lower lip; keep sparse slight chin stubble, no full beard. Remain clearly hand-inked illustration, not photographic.
3) Ensure anatomically sound five-finger hands, ball-contact hand naturally touching the upper ball surface; no merged or cropped fingers.

Keep the LEFT text layout, font, charcoal #151A18 / lime #CCF43B / ivory colors, supporting copy, orange basketball, hand-ink style and all editorial meaning unchanged. NO player name, personal stats, team names, jersey number, logos, or added copy. Do not reuse any text from the official photograph.
Exact text to retain:
バスケまとめ
2026.11.16｜試合前
今季平均EFF
ベスト5
B.PREMIER / B.ONE
リーグ別・登録選手から選出
